The '''Storthus system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Churba sector/Legends|Churba sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Storthus]].<ref name="The Kalarba Adventures 4" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Storthus system was established in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and released on [[August 18]], [[2009]],<ref name="TEA release date">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/185066/the-essential-atlas-star-wars-by-daniel-wallace-and-jason-fry|text=The Essential Atlas: Star Wars}}</ref> which placed the system in grid square P-15.<ref name="TEA" />
